use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Math = System.Math

let size = 480
let centre = cast double(size) / 2.0D
let radius = 208.0D

let ambient = 0.14D
let shine = 28.0D

let towards_light =
    (let x = -0.45D
     let y = 0.55D
     let z = 0.70D

     let length = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)

     (x = x / length, y = y / length, z = z / length))

channel(base: double, level: double, gloss: double) -> ubyte =>
    (let value = base * level + 255.0D * gloss

     cast ubyte(Math.min(255.0D, Math.max(0.0D, value))))

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

for down in 0..size do
    for across in 0..size do
        let x = (cast double(across) + 0.5D - centre) / radius
        let y = (centre - cast double(down) - 0.5D) / radius
        let square = x * x + y * y

        if square <= 1.0D then
            let z = Math.sqrt(1.0D - square)

            let lambert =
                x * towards_light.x +
                y * towards_light.y +
                z * towards_light.z

            let level = ambient + 0.9D * Math.max(0.0D, lambert)

            let gloss =
                Math.pow(
                    Math.max(
                        0.0D,
                        2.0D * lambert * z - towards_light.z
                    ),
                    shine
                )

            image.set_pixel(
                across, down,
                channel(70.0D, level, gloss),
                channel(130.0D, level, gloss),
                channel(235.0D, level, gloss)
            )
        fi
    od
od

image.write("sphere.png")

image.show("sphere.png")
